title.description: Opening or section slide: large centred title with an optional subtitle.

title-body.description: Headline on top, one body region below. The workhorse layout.

two-column.description: Headline plus two side-by-side regions for comparisons or text beside an image.

hero-image.description: Full-bleed image with a title and optional caption laid over it.

big-number.description: One headline figure (use a stat element) with a short caption.

quote.description: A single pull quote with attribution.

grid-3.description: Headline plus three equal cards, e.g. three pillars or three stats.

full-bleed.description: One unconstrained region covering the whole slide.

transitions.slide: New slide slides in from the right.
transitions.zoom: New slide scales up from slightly smaller.
transitions.push: New slide pushes the old one off to the left.
transitions.morph: Elements that share an id with the previous slide glide to their new position and size; the rest crossfade.

builds.fade-up: Fades in while rising slightly. The default.
builds.typewriter: Text types in character by character (headings, text and quotes).
builds.draw: Line art draws itself stroke by stroke (icons, diagrams and other SVG); anything else wipes in.

regionCapacityNote: Region numbers are rough character budgets used by the overflow lint; 0 means media only.

elements.heading: Headline. props: text, level 1-3.
elements.text: Paragraph of rich inline text. props: text.
elements.bullets: List. props: items[], ordered?, buildEach? (reveal one per step).
elements.image: Picture. props: src (https URL or /files/... from upload_asset), alt, decorative?, fit?, caption?.
elements.code: Syntax-highlighted code. props: code, language (typescript, javascript, tsx, json, bash, python, go, rust, sql, yaml, html, css, java, c, cpp, diff, markdown).
elements.stat: Big number that counts up. props: value, decimals?, prefix?, suffix?, label?.
elements.chart: Data chart drawn in the theme's colours; series draw in when shown. props: kind (bar|line|pie), labels[], series[{name?, values[], color?}], unit?, showValues?, caption?.
elements.diagram: Mermaid diagram (flowchart, sequence, timeline, etc.) themed automatically. props: source, caption?.
elements.icon: Line icon from the catalogue below. props: name, label?. Size with style.size, colour with style.color.
elements.shape: Simple shape or divider. props: kind (rect|circle|pill|line|arrow), fill?, label?.
elements.embed: Iframe (https) or video (https or /files/...). props: kind, src, title (iframes), poster?, autoplay?, loop?, muted?.
elements.html: Escape hatch: sandboxed raw HTML/CSS (no scripts). props: html, title. Use only when no other element fits; lint warns. Theme tokens are CSS variables like var(--sk-accent).
